translated_title: Homicides in Mexico Fell 16.6% in 2025, the Biggest Drop in the Last 12 Years
original_title: Los homicidios bajaron 16.6% en 2025: Inegi; es la mayor caída en los últimos 12 años

meta_description: Mexico logged 27,989 killings last year, its lowest tally in over a decade, with firearms behind 70.8% and killings down for both men and women.
